description: He wears a plum long-sleeved knee-length tunic with narrow gold woven neckline, front, cuff and hem borders over cream linen visible at neck, wrists and hem, a decorated brown leather belt with gold fittings and long hanging strap, brown trousers and tall brown leather boots. A cream woven shoulder wrap with plum and gold borders drapes from his left shoulder and is fastened with one round gold clasp. Both hands are visible. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible. Plain stone columns and doorway replace the prior wall hanging.
